choose.when: AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM vi_driver_assignment a WHERE a.order_id=o.id AND a.driver_id=#{scope.driverId})

mapper.select: SELECT o.* FROM vi_order o WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY o.created_at DESC,o.id DESC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vi_order o WHERE 1=1
SELECT o.* FROM vi_order o WHERE o.order_no=#{orderNo}
SELECT id FROM vi_driver_profile WHERE account_id=#{accountId}
SELECT id,order_id,driver_id,ended_at FROM vi_driver_assignment WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND driver_id=#{driverId} ORDER BY accepted_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id,order_id,driver_id,ended_at FROM vi_driver_assignment WHERE id=#{assignmentId} AND order_id=#{orderId} AND ended_at IS NULL
SELECT a.nickname FROM vi_driver_profile d JOIN vi_account a ON a.id=d.account_id WHERE d.id=#{driverId}
SELECT id,kind,case_status,approved_fen,return_state,refund_state,public_opinion,version FROM vi_aftersale_case WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT status FROM vi_dispute WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'OPEN' THEN 0 WHEN 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT review_status FROM vi_vehicle_license WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT conclusion FROM vi_inspection_result WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND superseded_at IS NULL

SELECT h.handover_type,e.mileage_km FROM vi_handover h JOIN vi_evidence_group e ON e.id=h.evidence_group_id WHERE h.order_id=#{orderId} AND e.order_id=h.order_id AND e.assignment_id=h.assignment_id AND e.status='SEALED' AND h.status='CONFIRMED' AND h.handover_type IN ('OWNER_TO_DRIVER','DRIVER_TO_OWNER') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vi_handover newer WHERE newer.order_id=h.order_id AND newer.handover_type=h.handover_type AND newer.status='CONFIRMED' AND (newer.confirmed_at>h.confirmed_at OR (newer.confirmed_at=h.confirmed_at AND newer.id>h.id)))
mapper.sql: WHERE (order_id=#{orderId} OR (aggregate_type='VI_ORDER' AND aggregate_id=#{orderId})) AND action IN #{action}
mapper.select: SELECT id,action,acting_role,DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS at FROM vi_event_log ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT station_snapshot FROM vi_order_snapshot WHERE order_id=#{orderId}
SELECT contact_cipher FROM vi_order_snapshot WHERE order_id=#{orderId}
